description: This file implements a FileWatcher class for monitoring file system events, processing file changes, and managing batch updates to a vector store, including handling ignored files, file size limits, and error telemetry.

classes.name: FileWatcher
classes.description: A class implementing file system watching, event batching, and processing logic for code indexing.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets up the file system watcher and event handlers.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources and event subscriptions.

methods.name: updateBatchSegmentThreshold
methods.description: Updates the batch segment size configuration.

methods.name: processFile
methods.description: Processes a single file: checks ignore rules, size, content changes, and prepares data for indexing.
